name: Ashaya, Soul of the Wild
oracle_text:
Ashaya's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
Nontoken creatures you control are Forest lands in addition to their other types. (They're still affected by summoning sickness.)
blocked_sentences: Ashaya's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
Nontoken creatures you control are Forest lands in addition to their other types. (They're still affected by summoning sickness.)

needs.what: A static value `count` (the `set_pt` characteristic-defining ability's "the number of lands you control") that sees the card types a layer-4 type-changing static grants (613.1d before 613.4), so Ashaya counts the nontoken creatures its own second line makes lands -- itself included -- and is 33/33, not 30/30, on a board of thirty lands and two other nontoken creatures.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Both lines are otherwise sayable: the second is {"effect": "add_subtype", "affects": {"controller": "you", "types": ["Creature"], "is_token": false}, "types": ["Land"], "subtypes": ["Forest"]}, and since basic_land_type_mana each such creature has 305.6's {T}: Add {G} (summoning sickness still applies, 302.6). The first is a self_only `set_pt` over a `count` of lands you control -- but characteristics._count_matching matches through _matches, which reads printed characteristics only (ADR 0001, docs/rules-coverage.md 'Fixed layer order'), so the count never sees the Land type the add_subtype static grants and Ashaya would be smaller by the number of nontoken creatures you control. Reading derived types there is the static-reads-static dependency ADR 0001 rules out, so this is a decision, not a missing key.
